summary: Verified GitHub token-paste bug fix. Backend /api/github/status now correctly returns connected:false when only a self_repo doc exists (no token_enc). Frontend Settings→API tab renders the GitHub card with a visible, typeable password input (settings-github-token-input) and Connect button (settings-github-connect) in the not-connected state. Bad-token connect attempt shows 'GitHub: Bad credentials' toast and status remains not connected. GithubPush dialog on /chat still renders github-token-input, and apikey-input-openai still renders. All targeted assertions pass.

minor.issue: Deletes the entire github_config doc (including self_repo). If a user has configured a self-update repo and then disconnects a token, self_repo is also wiped. Consider $unset only token_enc/login instead of delete_one.

action_items: (Optional) In DELETE /api/github/token, use $unset on token_enc/login rather than delete_one so self_repo is preserved.

(Env note only — does not affect the fix) WEBAUTHN_RP_ID in backend/.env is set to a different preview host (e9dda036…) than REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host (prom-metrics…). Passkey registration therefore fails from the prom-metrics origin ('rp.id is not a registrable domain suffix'). We worked around this by password-login (owner@example.com) + injecting the JWT into localStorage. If the app is intended to be served from prom-metrics.preview.emergentagent.com, align WEBAUTHN_RP_ID / WEBAUTHN_EXPECTED_ORIGIN to that host.
critical_code_review_comments: gh_status() fix is minimal and correct — fetches the full doc and gates connected on token_enc presence.
GithubKeyCard renders the input whenever status is loaded (not gated on !status.connected), matching the requested behavior; placeholder/button label toggle between Connect and Update.
test_credentials: owner@example.com / Prometheus#2026 (password login via POST /api/auth/login; JWT injected into localStorage 'promethius_token' for UI test to avoid the RP_ID/origin mismatch that blocks passkey registration).
seed_data_creation: None. Only transient github_config docs, all cleared via DELETE /api/github/token during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth in this preview env: WEBAUTHN_RP_ID=e9dda036-...preview.emergentagent.com but REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host is prom-metrics.preview.emergentagent.com → passkey registration from the prom-metrics origin fails at the browser (rp.id mismatch), and loading the app from the e9dda036 host hits CORS from CORS_ORIGINS. Easiest workaround: password-login (owner@example.com / Prometheus#2026) via /api/auth/login, then page.evaluate localStorage.setItem('promethius_token', <jwt>) on the prom-metrics origin. Settings modal is opened from the Orb via data-testid=orb-settings-button (there is NO sidebar/settings-link on / route), and the API tab via data-testid=settings-tab-api.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the reported 'no place to paste the token' bug was two-fold: (1) GET /api/github/status returned connected:true whenever ANY github_config doc existed for the user, including a self-repo-only doc created by PUT /api/github/self-config that had no token_enc — so the UI thought GitHub was already connected; (2) the frontend GithubKeyCard hid the input when status.connected was true. Both are fixed: gh_status now returns connected only when token_enc is present, and the input renders whenever status is loaded (placeholder+button label switch to Update when connected). Verified: (a) after PUT self-config with no token, GET /api/github/status → {connected:false}; (b) POST /api/github/token with a bogus token → 400 'GitHub: Bad credentials' and status stays connected:false; (c) in the UI, settings→API tab shows the GitHub card with a typeable password input and a Connect button in the not-connected state.
